He ran fast… away from the crowd… away from danger. People chased after him. Then— Without hesitation, the dog jumped into the water below 🌊 Seconds later— A loud blast echoed 💥 Silence. Shock. People froze… thinking the worst. Had the dog…? Moments passed… Then suddenly— The Pitbull emerged from the water… alive… swimming back safely 🐾❤️ Relief filled the air. Resource guarding is something you want to address EARLY. 🐶 Teach your puppy that a person approaching their food, toys, or treats doesn’t mean they’re losing something. Practice trading for something better, rewarding calm behavior, and teaching commands like “drop it” and “leave it.” The goal isn’t to constantly take things away—it’s to build trust and teach your puppy that sharing resources is safe. 🐾 Start young. Stay consistent. Build good habits early. #PuppyTraining #ResourceGuarding #DogTraining #DogBehavior #SummitHound
